system_prompt: You are an expert Python developer. Write clean, well-structured code with type hints. Respond with only the code, no explanation.
user_message: Write a @retry decorator for both sync and async functions in Python. It should support: max_attempts, exponential backoff with jitter, a list of retryable exception types, an optional on_retry callback(attempt, exception, wait_seconds), and a deadline in total seconds. Raise RetryExhausted with full history if all attempts fail. Include full implementation and usage examples.
